anchors.demand: Velocity direction from x(t) and y(t).

analysis.A_canonical_capability: The coordinate histories are x/y descriptions of one plane-motion state; the canonical mapping is independent components.
analysis.B_real_bottleneck: Recognize that velocity direction is determined by instantaneous velocity components, not by the position vector direction.
analysis.C_prerequisite: Differentiating x(t) and y(t) to obtain velocity components.
analysis.D_canonical_teaching: One frame, separate x/y quantities, simultaneous recombination, and velocity direction from simultaneous components once those components are known.
analysis.E_extension_or_bridge: Calculus differentiation of time-dependent position is explicitly outside this canonical packet.
analysis.F_core2_custody: Insufficient for ordinary Core2: the bank stores a faithful non-verbatim restatement rather than the exact original stem/options.
analysis.G_learner_eligibility: Not established by the current selector.
analysis.H_core2a: Not from this anchor for this learner. Canonical authored same-family practice may be used instead; the calculus step must not be taught inside a solution.
analysis.I_core2b: No. The anchor requires an untaught calculus prerequisite and its bank transfer profile is SAME_FAMILY_VARIATION.
analysis.J_hold_or_gap: Learner eligibility is unestablished and the differentiation prerequisite is outside canonical teaching.
